# Setup

```{r}
chain = params$chain

cat("chain:", chain, "\n")
```


## R library and data input

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(viridis)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(qvalue)
source("_utilities.R")

theme_set(theme_classic())
data_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_processed_data"
```


# Load data

## Read in data

These TCR data have already been aggregated at participant level and a TCR is defined by the aaSeq.  
```{r}
TCR_data   = fread(file.path(data_dir, sprintf("TCR_%s_5.tsv", chain)))
mut_data   = fread(file.path(data_dir, "mutation_freq_geq_5.tsv"))
sample_info = fread(file.path(data_dir, "sample_info_intersection.tsv"))

dim(TCR_data)
dim(mut_data)
dim(sample_info)

head(TCR_data)
head(mut_data)
head(sample_info)

participants = sample_info$participant

TCR_mat = get_TCR_matrix(TCR_data, participants)
mut_mat = get_mut_matrix(mut_data, participants)

dim(TCR_mat)
TCR_mat[1:2,1:3]

dim(mut_mat)
mut_mat[1:2,1:3]

stopifnot(setequal(participants, colnames(TCR_mat)))
stopifnot(setequal(participants, colnames(mut_mat)))

TCR_mat = TCR_mat[,match(participants, colnames(TCR_mat))]
mut_mat = mut_mat[,match(participants, colnames(mut_mat))]
```


## Check mutation frequency and TCR frequency

```{r}
n_per_mut = rowSums(mut_mat)
summary(n_per_mut)
table(n_per_mut >= 5)

mut_mat = mut_mat[which(n_per_mut >= 5),]
dim(mut_mat)
mut_mat[1:2,1:3]

n_per_TCR = rowSums(TCR_mat)
summary(n_per_TCR)
table(n_per_TCR >= 5)

TCR_mat = TCR_mat[which(n_per_TCR >= 5),]
dim(TCR_mat)
TCR_mat[1:2,1:3]
```

## Check associations between TCRs and mutations

```{r}
num_cores = 10

registerDoParallel(cores=num_cores)

TCR_rd  = sample_info$abundance
TCR_rd2 = colSums(TCR_mat)
summary(TCR_rd)
summary(TCR_rd2)
cor(TCR_rd, TCR_rd2, method = "spearman")

table(TCR_rd == 1)
table(TCR_rd == 2)
table(TCR_rd > 5)
table(TCR_rd > 10)

table(TCR_rd == 2)

table(TCR_rd2 > 0)

TCR_rd = log10(TCR_rd)
hist(TCR_rd, breaks = 50)

logistic_reg <- function(y, x, TCR_rd, l0){
    l1 = glm(y ~ x * TCR_rd, family = "binomial")
    lrt = anova(l0, l1, test = "LRT")
    
    lrt$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]
}

n_TCRs = nrow(TCR_mat)
n_muts = nrow(mut_mat)

date()
results <- foreach(i = 1:n_TCRs, .combine="rbind") %dopar% {
  y = TCR_mat[i,]
  l0 = glm(y ~ TCR_rd, family = "binomial")

  pvals <- sapply(1:n_muts, function(j) {
    logistic_reg(y, mut_mat[j,], TCR_rd=TCR_rd, l0=l0)
  })
  df1 = data.frame(TCR = rep(rownames(TCR_mat)[i], n_muts), 
                   mut = rownames(mut_mat), 
                   pval_LRT = pvals)
  df1
}
date()

rd_pval <- foreach(i = 1:n_TCRs, .combine="rbind") %dopar% {
  y = TCR_mat[i,]
  l0 = glm(y ~ 1, family = "binomial")
  l1 = glm(y ~ TCR_rd, family = "binomial")
  anova(l0, l1, test = "LRT")$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]
}

summary(rd_pval)
hist(rd_pval, main="", xlab="TCR-rd p-value by LRT", 
     breaks=seq(0,1,by=0.01))

dim(results)
head(results)

summary(results$pval_LRT)

hist(results$pval_LRT, main="", xlab="TCR-mutation p-value by LRT", 
     breaks=seq(0,1,by=0.01))

table(results$pval_LRT < 0.1)
nrow(results)*0.1

table(results$pval_LRT < 0.01)
nrow(results)*0.01

table(results$pval_LRT < 0.001)
nrow(results)*0.001

table(results$pval_LRT < 1e-4)
nrow(results)*1e-4

results = results[results$pval_LRT <= 0.50,]
dim(results)
summary(results$pval_LRT)

results = results[order(results$pval_LRT),]
results[1:10,]

fnm = file.path(data_dir, 
                sprintf("../_results/TCR_%s_mut_asso_rd_interaction.tsv", chain))
fwrite(results, file=fnm, sep="\t")
```
